text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's the day of the Satsuki Sho. Now that Mihono Bourbon has overcome her stamina hurdles, expectations for her are high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the race, Rice Shower extends a shaky hand toward the runner she so admires. Mihono Bourbon doesn't understand the gesture's meaning, but shakes her hand out of politeness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Round one of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho, begins now!
